Article Name: Anisotropic behavior in the flexural properties of aligned steel fiber UHPC produced by electromagnetic field
Author: Yongming Xiong, Ming Yang, Yan Yuan, Yan Liu, Jiankai Zhao, Heng Shi
Curing method: covered 24 h, demolded, steam curing 90 C RH>=95 % 48 h, then tested
Source table/page: Table 1 (mix), Table 2 (cube fc, T-random column), sect. 3.1-3.3 (curing, W/B)
Conversions / notes: S13-V1.0 straight steel fiber (0.2 mm dia, >1800 MPa). Only the T-random (conventional, no magnetic alignment) cubes are used; aligned specimens skipped. Mix by weight ratio to cement 1:0.34:0.28 (cement:SF:FA), sand 1.1 (80 % coarse silica sand + 20 % fine sand), SP 0.018; re-expressed per B = 1.62. VERIFY: test age 3 d derived (24 h mold + 48 h steam, tested after). Sibling paper 10.1016/j.jobe.2024.111092 reports identical cube values with sand 1.7 and water 0.32 (W/B 0.198); W/B 0.17 of this paper used.
